name: pokoin-web
description: Pokoin marketplace SPA (Solid, solid/; shared modules in market/), landing, workers. Dev preview = vite in solid/.

worktree.setup: cd market && npm ci && cd ../solid && npm ci

test.command: node --test market/src/*.test.js && cd solid && npm test

build.description: Full web build (scripts/build-web.sh, same as Vercel and Cloudflare)

web.description: Solid Vite dev server on the Paseo-assigned port, reverse-proxied at web--<branch>--<project>.localhost:<daemon-port>
